Q : What is the ideal structure for a nursing assignment in the UK?

An ideal nursing assignment in the UK typically follows the academic format and expectations set out by the universities as well as the NMC learning outcomes. These usually include:
  • Introduction:  It briefly introduces the topic, clinically relevant definitions, and objectives for the assignment. https://imac.gob.mx/imac/
  • Main Body:  Divided into thematic sections, underpinned by evidence-based literature clinical guidelines (such as NICE), and nursing frameworks.
  • Critical Analysis:  Engaging with the theories of Gibbs Reflective Cycle, Orem’s Model, or Roper-Logan-Tierney for applying knowledge gained.
  • Conclusion:  Summarise significant findings and implications for clinical practice.
  • References:  Stand either in APA 7th or Harvard style, depending on the guidelines of universities.
